title: A move of the pointer checkout off main during a session is refused or seen, not found 1.5 days later
why: Incident (lane notes-fix-large-1, session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m, reported 11:31 CST Nov 9): in that lane's cloud container the pointer checkout /home/user/claude-settings sat detached at 174b005c1 (merge of #1423, batch 57) from 2026-11-07 20:03 UTC, while local main was at 5cc641f78. Every hook, lint and agent there ran that old code for about 1.5 days; agents had seen the installed guard match neither base, head nor main. Found when the pointer-head guard refused a checkout; the lane fast-forwarded to origin/main 81a720c42 at 11:40 CST on a clean tree. The reflog entry has an empty message, which points to update-ref or a tool, not a plain checkout; the mover is unknown. Review verdicts are not affected: reviewers probed each PR's own code, and lane lint ran from the merge tree.
note: Which guard should have caught it: none does today. hooks/session_start.sh reports a pointer off main only at session start or resume, and says "reported here, never fixed here"; a move after start goes unseen. The pointer-head guard reads checkout and switch words, not update-ref or a tool that moves HEAD. Fix options: (a) the pointer-head guard refuses any git command that writes the pointer's HEAD (update-ref, reset, switch, checkout) outside the install path; (b) the Stop hook or report guard reads the pointer HEAD once per turn and flags a detach off main and origin/main (a read inside a process already running, rule outcomes-mechanize-rules). First find the mover: read that container's transcripts near 2026-11-07 20:03 UTC. Related: steps pointer-checkout-edit, pointer-head-own-detach. Owner of the lane: the coordinator, starting right after batch 68 merges (11:34 CST Nov 9). Second finding (coordinator 11:34 CST): in its container the pointer /root/claude-settings-main is on main 81a720c42 (no drift), yet hooks/session_start.sh printed "has local commits on main that main lacks" while origin/main..HEAD is empty. A likely false alarm: give it a red row first. Batch 68 merged (#2449, 11:55 CST Nov 9): free to start. Lane session_013NEJKzpdAiMKMRoL5YWGDX started 12:13 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Coordinator (13:46 CST Nov 9): GLOSSARY.md has no row for "pointer checkout", which this step and the new guard rule pointer-edit (#2456) use. After #2456 lands, a record-writer adds the row. Not an owner question.
